description: Front (e): the stated evidence for (H1) c_3^even = -Vol(4_1) has no discriminating power at present resolution. The corpus quotes 'c_3 agrees with -Vol(4_1) to ~0.48%' (0.07% muon), which compares CENTRAL VALUES while omitting sigma(c_3) = +/-1.262 CAL-3 propagated — 62% of |c_3|. Derived here as sigma(Q_beta)/(Q_N2 u^3) from the committed CAL-3 input rather than quoted, reproducing 1.262. In sigma the agreements are 0.031 (proton) and 0.008 (muon): not strong evidence but NO evidence, since every candidate within the band agrees as well. The 1-sigma acceptance is 51x wider than the 0.0491 genericity window the 7/7-constants result used, so that result understates the problem by ~51x. Testability needs 32x (proton) / 130x (muon) sharper Q_beta, bracketing the 25.68x the zero-location test needs — same lever. Scope-(a): does NOT refute (H1).
tier: error propagation on committed values (no fit)
